نجرنثم (form IIIq)
# نَجْرَنْثِمُ (najranṯimu) /nad͡ʒ.ran.θi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# نَجْرَنْثِمَ (najranṯima) /nad͡ʒ.ran.θi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
# نَجْرَنْثِمْ (najranṯim) /nad͡ʒ.ran.θim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِجْرَنْثَمَ (ijranṯama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
